entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Are you leaving?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Come back here. Let's talk for a moment.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, Futaba-chan asked you to come[n]back!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We should go talk to her.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Welcome back. I had thought I would[n]never see you again.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, I wonder why—I can't believe you[n]tried to crush us with an effing boulder!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You want us to steal your goddamn[n]Treasure or not?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Hm, why don't we make a deal? You[n]wish to proceed further, yes?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A deal, you say?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: There is a town nearby. I would like you[n]to take back that which the bandit there[n]stole from me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah, I think I remember seeing[n]a town on the way here.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: If you bring what was stolen back to me,[n]I will give you a reward. I'll even tell you[n]how to proceed.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Can't you tell us any more details?[n]Anything about this bandit, or what[n]was stolen?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: You'll learn all the information you need[n]to know once you arrive.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll need to head outside if we want to[n]go to the town. We can go when you're[n]ready, Joker.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Take back what that bandit stole from me.[n]He should be in the nearby town.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're back. This is the thing you said[n]they stole, right?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Well done. It is yours now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, what? Didn't you want us to get it[n]back because it's important?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: That is a map of the tomb, stolen by[n]the bandit to aid in his ransacking of[n]this place.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why are you letting them just do[n]whatever they want? This is your[n]Palace, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: All that matters is that the map is now[n]yours. Just come further in and... Oh.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What in the—?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? Futaba-chan disa—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Goddammiiiiiiiiiiit!
